```yaml
name: Publish Daily Repo Status

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Generate daily status
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          TODAY: $(date +%Y-%m-%d)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Fetch merged PRs in the last 48 hours
          MERGED_PR_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/pulls?state=closed&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=100"
          MERGED_PR_JSON=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" "${MERGED_PR_URL}")
          MERGED_PR_IDS=$(echo "$MERGED_PR_JSON" | jq -r '.[] | select(.merged_at != null and (.merged_at | fromdateiso8601) >= (now - 172800)) | .number')

          # Build markdown for merged PRs
          echo "## ✅ Recently Merged (Last 48 Hours)" > status.md
          echo "" >> status.md
          echo "| # | Title | Author |" >> status.md
          echo "|---|-------|--------|" >> status.md
          for PR in $MERGED_PR_IDS; do
            PR_INFO=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/pulls/${PR}")
            TITLE=$(echo "$PR_INFO" | jq -r '.title')
            AUTHOR=$(echo "$PR_INFO" | jq -r '.user.login')
            echo "| [#$PR](https://github.com/${REPO}/pull/$PR) | $TITLE | @$AUTHOR |" >> status.md
          done

          # Fetch open PRs
          OPEN_PR_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/pulls?state=open&per_page=100"
          OPEN_PR_JSON=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" "${OPEN_PR_URL}")
          OPEN_PR_IDS=$(echo "$OPEN_PR_JSON" | jq -r '.[].number')

          # Build markdown for open PRs
          echo "" >> status.md
          echo "## 🔄 Open Pull Requests (Needs Attention)" >> status.md
          echo "" >> status.md
          echo "| # | Title | Author |" >> status.md
          echo "|---|-------|--------|" >> status.md
          for PR in $OPEN_PR_IDS; do
            PR_INFO=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/pulls/${PR}")
            TITLE=$(echo "$PR_INFO" | jq -r '.title')
            AUTHOR=$(echo "$PR_INFO" | jq -r '.user.login')
            echo "| [#$PR](https://github.com/${REPO}/pull/$PR) | $TITLE | @$AUTHOR |" >> status.md
          done

          # Save the markdown to a file
          mkdir -p daily-status
          mv status.md daily-status/${TODAY}.md

      - name: Commit and push status
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add daily-status/${TODAY}.md
          git commit -m "Daily repo status for ${TODAY}"
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
